verdict.rationale: DPMA is a public IP-office web service whose site could plausibly publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows only human-oriented filing and search pages, and no llms.txt or agent-facing documentation. The only machine-access probe found register.dpma.de/robots.txt disallowing general crawling, which points away from agent-friendly access rather than toward it.
